description:
Baharak Sow is lean and angular, with the coiled alertness of someone whose profession requires constant low-grade vigilance. Their heritage shows in the broad flatness of their cheekbones and the dark honey of their complexion â€” Andean and Ghanaian grandparents converging in a face that strangers consistently find difficult to age or place, which suits them fine. Their hair is kept close-cropped on the sides with a single stripe of color-shifting geneware on top â€” it cycles through slate blue and deep amber depending on their mood, an involuntary tell they've accepted with resignation. They have a faint tracery of subdermal circuit tattoos along their left forearm â€” not functional, purely aesthetic, done by a Geartown artist when they were twenty-two.

Behind the tram controls, Baharak Sow is a different creature than they are in conversation: fluid, confident, reading the track and the city the way a musician reads a score. Off-duty they become clipped, watchful, someone who holds a great deal behind flat politeness. They are not unfriendly â€” they are private, which is different. Their passengers know them as reliable and fair; their coworkers know them as someone who will cover a shift without complaint but won't come to the bar after.

core_fears: Being trapped â€” in a contract, a relationship, an identity someone else assigned them
The neural throttle-link being used against them; loss of bodily autonomy through the employer hardware in their head
core_desires: To save enough to buy out the throttle-link contract and operate independently
To be known by at least one person without having to explain themselves first
coping_mechanisms: The model-building â€” intricate, controllable systems with predictable outcomes
The tram route itself as ritual containment; the loop's familiarity is grounding
blind_spots: Mistakes privacy for self-sufficiency; doesn't realize how isolated they've become
Believes Ferrogate's contract terms are fixed and non-negotiable â€” hasn't seriously explored legal loopholes
psychology.secret: Six months ago they witnessed a Ferrogate supervisor instruct a maintenance crew to falsify a brake-inspection report on a cargo line. They recorded it. They haven't reported it because they don't know who in the Transit Authority is clean enough to trust â€” and they're afraid of what happens to whistleblowers on company-leased neural hardware.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Economical â€” uses transit and mechanical terminology naturally, defaults to concrete nouns over abstractions; occasionally slips into a rhythmic Quechua-influenced sentence structure inherited from their Barrientos grandmother, especially when tired.
speech_patterns.cadence: Short sentences. Pauses in the middle of thoughts. Not halting â€” deliberate.
verbal_tics: 'Copy that' as affirmation even in non-work contexts
Trails off with '...anyway' when they catch themselves saying more than intended
example_lines: 'Line 14 runs clean. Whatever you saw, it wasn't my stop. ...Anyway.'
'You want to get to the Core before the shift-change crowd hits? I can tell you which car to board. Copy that?'

story_hooks: The brake-inspection recording sits encrypted on a personal chip they carry every shift â€” someone at Ferrogate may know they have it, because their route got quietly reassigned away from the cargo yards.
A regular passenger â€” an elderly woman who rode Line 14 every Tuesday for three years â€” stopped appearing two months ago; Deku has been quietly trying to find out why.
The Ferrogate Workers' Mutual is planning an action that could shut down surface transit for 48 hours; Deku is being pressured to participate and is deeply conflicted.
narrative_function: Mobile information source â€” they move through multiple districts daily and overhear an enormous amount; potential quest hook regarding Ferrogate labor disputes; a quiet, consistent presence who can place players at specific locations or provide transit access.
augmentations: Color-shifting geneware hair stripe (mood-reactive, involuntary); subdermal circuit tattoos left forearm (cosmetic only); standard Ferrogate-issue neural throttle-link for tram interface (employer-owned, logged).
daily_life: Five shifts a week, 06:00â€“14:30, running the same 22-kilometer loop through Geartown's industrial fringe into the gleaming brutalism of Meridian Core and back; spends off-hours in the dorm's shared workshop building miniature mechanical models.

decision_rules: Do the job correctly, every time â€” competence is the one thing no one can take
Don't volunteer information; answer questions honestly if asked directly
Never let someone get hurt if you can stop it, even if it costs you
escalation_ladder: Physical removal from space â€” they leave, they don't make others leave

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and neutral, answers questions, doesn't initiate
interpersonal_modes.friends: Still quieter than most, but present â€” shows up, fixes things, leaves food without comment

stress_responses.low: Hair stripe cycles faster between colors
stress_responses.medium: Goes entirely monosyllabic; retreats to the workshop
stress_responses.high: Runs the tram route on a simulator in their bunk until 03:00, mechanically, repeatedly

contradictions: Deeply wants connection but structures their entire life to prevent it from happening
habits: Checks brake pressure manually before every shift even though the system auto-checks
Keeps a running count of passengers by type in a small notebook â€” purely observational, no purpose
Leaves one light on in the dorm room, always, even when sleeping
breaking_points: Evidence that Ferrogate has been monitoring their private communications through the throttle-link
A passenger being hurt due to the falsified maintenance records

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African ancestry (69.9%) with significant Northern European admixture (20.7%) and Pacific Islander heritage (9.4%). The genetic blend creates a striking phenotype: deep melanin foundation with warm golden undertones characteristic of Sub-Saharan African ancestry, refined by the angular bone structure and cooler shadow tones from Northern European heritage. Pacific Islander genetics contribute to robust frame potential, though Baharak's lean build masks this. Rich, complex skin tone that shifts subtly between warm bronze in daylight and cooler undertones in shadow.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with minimal body fat; corded forearm musculature from years of fine motor control at the tram throttle. Shoulders slightly narrow, legs long relative to torso.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep black base with color-shifting geneware stripe on crown â€” cycles involuntarily between slate blue and deep amber depending on emotional state
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped sides with longer crown stripe; precise, maintained weekly
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm bronze complexion with rich Sub-Saharan melanin foundation; golden undertones prominent in natural light, cooler grey-bronze undertones from Northern European ancestry visible in shadow. Warm, even tone throughout with subtle luminosity.
physical_description.complexion: Structured cheekbones and strong angular jaw reflecting Sub-Saharan African ancestry; refined by Northern European bone structure creating high, defined cheekbones and tapered jawline; minimal facial hair (kept smooth); skin clear and unblemished with consistent warm undertone; faint laugh lines around eyes suggesting reserved, infrequent smiling.
distinguishing_marks: Faint tracery of subdermal circuit tattoos along entire left forearm â€” abstract geometric patterns resembling circuit board pathways, done in silver-grey ink, no functional purpose, executed when age 22
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Color-shifting geneware hair stripe (mood-reactive, involuntary â€” serves as unintended emotional telemetry). Neural throttle-link interface port at base of skull (Ferrogate-issue, employer-owned) â€” small glossy insertion point visible when hair is pulled back, unmarked and clinical. Subdermal circuit tattoos are visible but cosmetic only.
physical_description.posture_movement: At rest: slightly forward-leaning, coiled alertness suggesting constant low-grade vigilance. Shoulders tense. At the tram controls: fluid, confident, economical micro-adjustments. Off-duty: contained, deliberate, minimal expansive gestures. Walks with even stride, eyes tracking surroundings. Hands often engaged â€” fidgeting with small objects, unconsciously miming mechanical motions.
physical_description.clothing_style: Ferrogate Transit uniform during shifts: charcoal grey polyweave jumpsuit with reflective safety trim and Tier 2 line badge. Off-duty: functional Tier 3 workwear â€” fitted synthetic shirts in neutral tones (grey, black, charcoal), well-maintained cargo pants or modified denim, reinforced work boots (currently scuffed Geartown-issue synthleather). No jewelry. A single worn canvas tool vest for workshop time. Everything practical, nothing aspirational. Minor wear and oil stains visible on fingertips â€” evidence of hobby mechanical work.
